title: DFT total energy calculations of Al trimer configurations
action: Construct a six-layer Al(111) slab with a (5×5) surface cell and vacuum region. Place Al trimers in the following configurations: compact triangular (FCC-H, HCP-H, FCC-T, HCP-T), linear (FCC-L, HCP-L), and eight non-compact triangular (1F2H-120°, 2F1H-150°, 1F2H-150°, 3H-120°, 2F1H-120°, 3F-120°, 2F1H-90°, 1F2H-90°). For each configuration, relax the trimer atoms and the top three slab layers while keeping the bottom three layers fixed at bulk LDA positions. Use LDA exchange-correlation, an appropriate plane-wave cutoff and k-point mesh. Converge total energies, then compute relative energies (eV) referenced to the most stable configuration. Output the relative energies to a CSV file.
description: CSV file containing relative total energies of all Al trimer configurations on Al(111) surface.
output_schema: Columns: configuration (string) – name of the trimer configuration; relative_energy_eV (float) – total energy relative to the most stable configuration in electron-volts. Rows must include all configurations listed in the action.

title: DFT energy barrier calculations for selected diffusion paths
action: Using the relaxed structures from the previous step, compute diffusion barriers for: (a) concerted translation FCC-H ↔ HCP-T, (b) concerted translation FCC-T ↔ HCP-H, (c) transformation path from compact triangular to linear trimers via non-compact intermediates (e.g. FCC-H → 1F2H-120° → FCC-L → 2F1H-120° → HCP-H), and (d) intercell translation of linear trimer FCC-L ↔ HCP-L. Use the nudged elastic band (NEB) method or constrained relaxations. For each path report the maximum energy barrier along the minimal-energy pathway.
description: CSV file listing energy barriers for the key diffusion mechanisms of Al trimers on Al(111) surface.
output_schema: Columns: diffusion_path (string) – short descriptor of the diffusion path; barrier_eV (float) – computed energy barrier in electron-volts. Must include entries for the concerted FCC-H↔HCP-T translation, the triangular-to-linear transformation, and the linear intercell translation.
